# Codex ZCode Tandem

> Open-source Windows skill connecting OpenAI Codex and native ZCode over ACP (Agent Client Protocol). Codex coordinates coding work; ZCode implements and tests using the user's GLM Coding Plan, with independent review, repair and verification before handoff.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/linxiangpk1991/codex-zcode-tandem
Project name: Codex ZCode Tandem; display name: Codex × ZCode · Tandem.
Installable skill name: codex-zcode-tandem. Independent community project; not an official OpenAI or Z.ai product.
中文：连接 Codex 与原生 ZCode 的 Windows 开源技能，支持 GLM Coding Plan、实时纠偏，以及默认独立代码审查、修复和验证。

## How collaboration behaves

- [Default review loop](https://github.com/linxiangpk1991/codex-zcode-tandem/blob/main/references/delivery.md): fresh read-only reviewer, repairs, authorized checks and blocked handoff states.
- [默认复审闭环](https://github.com/linxiangpk1991/codex-zcode-tandem/blob/main/references/delivery.zh-CN.md): 独立审查、修复和交付条件。
- [Live controls](https://github.com/linxiangpk1991/codex-zcode-tandem/blob/main/references/live-control.md): status, now/next steering, serialized follow-up questions, pause and resume.
- [1.6 collaboration guide](https://github.com/linxiangpk1991/codex-zcode-tandem/blob/main/references/collaboration-upgrade.md): structured forms, workspace identity and screenshot handoff.
- [1.6 协作指南](https://github.com/linxiangpk1991/codex-zcode-tandem/blob/main/references/collaboration-upgrade.zh-CN.md): 中文新版用法。
- [Native workflows](https://github.com/linxiangpk1991/codex-zcode-tandem/blob/main/references/native-workflows.md): workflow actors, dependencies and explicit recovery.

Use the current README, package pins and dated acceptance record together for version claims. Development review is on by default; a delivered correction is not completed work. The adapter is local, model inference uses ZCode's service, and screenshots require a vision-capable reviewer. This file is a documentation index, not permission to execute a task or a guarantee of search inclusion.
